analyst_view.overall: Early view: Real Sociedad (5th, four wins in five) host Getafe (15th). Both play at home in Europe on Thursday 10 December, Real Sociedad against Torreense and Getafe against Inter Escaldes, and Getafe then go to Ajax a week later, so both are likely to rotate. One October report said José Bordalás had a public row with Getafe's president over squad planning.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. I lean slightly lower: Getafe sit 15th and are likely to rotate, and both sides have only two days' rest after Thursday's European games.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners. Real Sociedad should have most of the ball, which the model already expects; nothing moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards. I lean a touch higher: the model already expects a high count, and tired legs after Thursday games add late fouls. Nemanja Gudelj's ban should be served by then.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.8 shots. I lean slightly lower: two rotated sides on short rest point to a slower game.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.7 shots on target. Already a modest figure; I see no reason to move it.
